Est actio civilis bonæ fidei in personam, per quam

Est actio prætoria bonæ fidei personalis, ex quasi
contractu proveniens, qua, qui alterius negotium si-
ne mandato ac sponte sua gessit, quicquid con nomi-
ne illi vel abest vel abfuturum est, a domino repetit:
vicissimque illi actus sui rationem probare, & si quid
vel non, ut oportuerit, gesserit, vel ex his negotiis qd[?]
setinuerit[?],
præstare cogitur. l. 2. ff. de negot. gest.

page.notes: The running head is printed in spaced capitals ("Iu R I s."), given here as IURIS. The first line of the page is a continuation fragment from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "noftio" (after "Titulo"), "qd" and "setinuerit" (the printed letters are hard to read at the line end, and the reading "continuerit" is an inference). The stray marks at top right and the spots at the foot are stains and are not transcribed.
